name: django-model-navigator
description: Navigation through Django models: Ctrl+Click, tooltips and autocomplete

djangoModelNavigator.debug.markdownDescription: Write a detailed log to the `Django Model Navigator` output channel (scanned files, found models, rescan reasons). Errors are logged regardless of this setting.

djangoModelNavigator.additionalModelPath.markdownDescription: Additional glob patterns for searching for models (for example, `**/db_models.py`, `**/models/*.py`). `**/models.py` is always used automatically.

djangoModelNavigator.excludePatterns.description: Glob patterns excluded from the model search.

djangoModelNavigator.additionalFieldType.markdownDescription: Extra field types that do not end with `Field` and are not recognized automatically (for example, `TaggableManager`).

djangoModelNavigator.userModel.markdownDescription: Model used for `settings.AUTH_USER_MODEL` references (for example, `accounts.User`). Leave empty to detect it automatically by `AbstractUser` / `AbstractBaseUser` inheritance.

djangoModelNavigator.includeBuiltinModel.markdownDescription: Add Django's own models (`auth.User`, `Group`, `Permission`, `ContentType`, `Session`, `sites.Site`, `admin.LogEntry`) to the cache. Without them chains through `ForeignKey(User)` break. A project model with the same name always wins.

djangoModelNavigator.hoverMaxFields.description: Maximum number of fields shown in a tooltip.

djangoModelNavigator.maxDefinitionResult.description: Maximum number of candidates offered by Go to Definition when the target is ambiguous.

djangoModelNavigator.enableDefinition.description: Enable Go to Definition for models and fields.

djangoModelNavigator.enableHover.description: Enable tooltips for models and fields.

djangoModelNavigator.enableReferences.markdownDescription: Enable Find All References for models: relation fields pointing at a model and inheritance from it.

djangoModelNavigator.enableCodeLens.description: Show a CodeLens above each model declaration with field, reverse relation and usage counts.

viewsWelcome.contents:
No models indexed yet. Open a Django workspace and rebuild the cache.
[Rebuild Model Cache](command:djangoModelNavigator.updateCache)
For split model packages, add `**/models/*.py` to `djangoModelNavigator.additionalModelPaths`.
